points.point: Why Blotato can't read the artifact link
points.sentence: A claude.ai/artifact link is not a public image file, and Blotato cannot read the image from it.

points.point: How to get slides in: export from Claude
points.sentence: Export the image files from Claude before posting.

points.point: How to get slides in: download files
points.sentence: Download the PNG files to your computer.

points.point: How to get slides in: upload in editor
points.sentence: Open your draft in the Blotato Post editor and click Photo / Video.

verdict.reason: The entry covers the unreadable claude.ai/artifact link and gives the steps to export, download and upload the images.
